title: Guard
description: Holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, Remove-Item -Recurse, git reset --hard, git clean -f, force push, branch -D, DROP TABLE) until you confirm them, in every permission mode.
access: Reads each Bash and PowerShell command Claude runs. Runs git status to count what a reset or clean would lose. Refuses a command you decline. No network or model calls.

title: Meter
description: Context fill, session cost, rate-limit use and tool calls on the status line, with a nudge past 80% context.
access: Reads session usage and counts tool calls in memory. No files, processes, network or persistence.

title: Orchestrator
description: The orchestrate skill for splitting work across parallel subagents, and a band above the prompt listing the agents running.
access: Observes subagent starts and finishes and the session's agent list. No files, processes, network or persistence.
